[EN] I believe we could win some of the orcan tribes over if it weren't for the besharan merchants. {@LinkCreature:241#1022$$Paduk} says they sell the rock tribe a fiery liquor that incites them to violence.

Waylaying {@LinkCreature:41#2006#besharan smugglers} and {@LinkCreature:41#2002#enforcers} or their caiman {@LinkCreature:41#4010#porters} and {@LinkCreature:41#4009#guards} and taking their liquor might be the solution. Are you willing?
[ES] Creo que podríamos ganarnos a algunas de las tribus orcas si no fuera por los comerciantes besharan. {@LinkCreature:241#1022$$Paduk} dice que le venden a la tribu de la roca un licor ardiente que los incita a la violencia.

Emboscar a los {@LinkCreature:41#2006#besharan smugglers} y {@LinkCreature:41#2002#enforcers}, o a sus {@LinkCreature:41#4010#porters} y {@LinkCreature:41#4009#guards} caimán, y quitarles el licor podría ser la solución. ¿Estás dispuesto?

[EN] The besharans will not be so eager to poison the minds of the orcans now! Thank you.
[ES] ¡Los besharan ya no estarán tan ansiosos por envenenar las mentes de los orcos! Gracias.

[EN] Don't underestimate the besharans—they're small, but fierce.
[ES] No subestimes a los besharan; son pequeños, pero feroces.
